subject: Compute roster clearance: Aurametrics late-stage sizing and short lock
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Aurametrics - quick availability check + short lock request

Team —

Aurametrics (Eva) is asking for a short runway confirmation after our exec demo. They want a tight commitment window to hit their procurement cadence; legal + procurement have signaled a Dec end cadence but engineering wants availability guarantees that map to their go-live in Feb. High level requirements from the last call: 

- Model: fine-tuned Llama-2-70B variant (dense -> we suggested q4/mixed quantization for throughput)
- Expected steady concurrency: 120 concurrent sessions (chat), peak concurrency bursts to ~220 for short windows during onboarding
- Typical context window: 4k tokens; some evals up to 8k
- Latency SLO: 99th < 350ms for generation tail (we'll accept fallback to a quantized alt if necessary)
- Throughput pattern: steady daytime QPS ~180 reqs/min, spikes up to ~420 reqs/min for 10-20 minute windows during events

Ask: can we get an internal compute roster snapshot and a short soft-block (14–30 days) for the equivalent capacity (A100-80GB or H100-equivalent)? Please call out: number of GPUs, whether Dedicated pool can be carved for them, and fallback model variants we can auto-route to.

Can Monica or Ops confirm feasibility and whether we need to escalate to Dedicated capacity reservations? If we can get a soft-lock for ~16x A100-80GB equiv (or 8x H100 with SLOs adjusted), that would buy time for procurement.

Thanks — I need this in the next 48 hours to set expectations with Eva.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-02T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurametrics - quick availability check + short lock request

Monica —

Looping you in to prioritize a roster check. Key points to validate:

1) SKU mapping: what is the current fleet mix for US central (primary region for Aurametrics)? How many A100-80GB and H100 nodes are free vs. committed for Jan-Feb?

2) Equivalent sizing: Aditya suggested 16x A100-80GB equiv. Please provide alternative mappings (e.g., 8x H100, 20x A40) and the expected headroom for the 99th latency target.

3) Soft-block window: can we apply a 14-day soft-block in the system (no charge, prevents commitments) and extend to 30 days if procurement milestones are met? If a soft-block is not supported, what is the minimal commitment policy?

4) Fallback policy: identify which quantized / trimmed model variants are compatible with automatic routing when we hit capacity limits.

Please include a snapshot (spreadsheet) of current roster allocations and note any upcoming scheduled maintenance that could affect availability in Jan. Aditya needs this to update the customer by EOD Thursday PST.

If you prefer, I can spin up a quick call with ops and product to discuss the exact node mapping — but a spreadsheet first would be ideal.

Rishi
VP, Strategic Accounts
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-04T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aurametrics - quick availability check + short lock request

Rishi / Aditya —

Attached: gpu_roster_snapshot.xlsx (current allocations across US-central, US-east) and a short note (aurametrics_requirements_v2.pdf) summarizing the mapping. Summary below: 

- Fleet snapshot (US-central): total usable inference nodes equivalent to 420 A100-80GB; of those, ~342 are currently committed across Dedicated pools and active Hosted workloads.

- Immediate available headroom: ~78 A100-80GB equiv. Mapping options for Aurametrics: 
  - Option A (latency-first): 16x A100-80GB dedicated carve (recommended) — meets 99th < 350ms in our performance tests for 4k context at expected concurrency; provides 20% burst headroom.
  - Option B (cost/efficiency): 8x H100 with optimized batching — similar tail latency for q4m quantized model but slightly higher variance on bursts; requires additional tuning.
  - Option C (mixed): 12x A100 + 4x H100 burst pool — flexible but requires routing policy to split traffic by SKU and model variant.

- Soft-block policy: we can place a system-level soft-block (pre-commit) for up to 21 days. After 21 days ops will surface a reminder; converting to a true reservation requires a written PO/commit. The soft-block prevents other sales-assigned Dedicated allocations but does not physically remove capacity from the Hosted pool.

- Maintenance windows: No major infra maintenance scheduled in Jan for US-central; a minor kernel patch is scheduled 2029-01-10 (2hr window) but we can route around affected nodes.

Next steps I took: 
- Created a 14-day soft-block for Aurametrics equivalent to Option A (16x A100-80GB) starting 2029-12-05. Entry: "DEAL-1783 soft-block - Rishi/Aditya"
- Attached roster and preliminary routing notes (see spreadsheet tab 'routing').

If Aditya wants a 30-day window we need a documented procurement milestone (e.g., signed MSA or PO). Happy to prep the reservation path + pricing delta if they push for hard commit.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: gpu_roster_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]
[Attachment: aurametrics_requirements_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Eva Martinez <eva@aurametrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-12-11T16:44:00-08:00
Subject: Aurametrics compute runway update & next steps

Eva —

Quick update from our side after an internal roster check: we placed a 14-day soft-block for the equivalent of 16x A100-80GB in US-central to support your late-stage ramp. This soft-block prevents other sales reservations while you finalize procurement; it does not convert to a paid reservation. Monica attached the roster snapshot and a recommended mapping (Option A) that matches your latency SLOs.

Action items for Aurametrics to lock the reservation: 
- Send a signed MSA or a purchase order to procurement@redwood.com within the next 14 days (Dec 25 cut-off) to convert the soft-block into a firm reservation.
- Confirm whether you want us to enable automatic fallback routing to the q4m quantized variant when burst utilization triggers routing policies (we recommended yes).

If you'd like, we can schedule a short 30-minute call this week to run through the routing rules and demo an auto-fallback scenario with a synthetic spike.

Thanks and congrats again on the demo — we want to make this as frictionless as possible on our end.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
